title.value: Gradient Masked Averaging for Federated Learning
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: Gradient Masked Averaging for Federated Learning

extractions.description: This paper introduces a gradient masked averaging approach for federated learning to improve generalization across clients with heterogeneous data. The method focuses on learning invariant mechanisms while ignoring spurious ones, showing consistent improvements in various experiments.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving the efficiency and robustness of federated learning algorithms, but does not explicitly focus on sustainable development goals. While it mentions the lower carbon footprint of federated learning, this is a secondary consideration.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Parcollet et al. (2021) and Qiu et al. (2021) argue that federated learning has a lower carbon footprint than traditional machine learning.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not directly address any of the primary categories. Although it discusses reducing the carbon footprint of ML, it is not the primary focus.
primary_category.quote: Parcollet et al. (2021) and Qiu et al. (2021) argue that federated learning has a lower carbon footprint than traditional machine learning

primary_sub_category.quote: Federated learning (FL) is an emerging paradigm that permits a large number of clients with heterogeneous data to coordinate learning of a unified global model without the need to share data amongst each other.
